expected_response.incumbent_fallback: Incumbent D2_without_trajectory_static retained unchanged; no temperature edit proposed.
expected_response.primary_reason: No permitted bounded declarative edit acts on the pair-kernel or shape observables that carry the strongest signed endpoint contrasts, and the temporal evidence does not validate a time-conditioned alternative.

failure_modes: An edit to pointcloud_delta_A would change only the endpoint-distance curvature, not the pair-kernel or shape observables that carry the signed contrasts, so it cannot be expected to move the favored contrast.

An edit to region_index or temporal_region_index would reweight landmark attention without a validated time-conditioned contrast; the curve-fidelity audit retains none of the audited landmark/pair curves, so the attention change is unsupported.
An edit to teacher_neighbors would change only the detached nearest-k count; neighbor count is not a distance bandwidth and does not act on the pair-distance shell density.
An edit to temporal_teacher_blend would mix static and observed-teacher coordinate rewards without a validated temporal contrast, and a temporal derivative is not a spatial gradient.
Treating pair-kernel, shape or joint-motion contrasts as if the executing pointcloud scalar contained those terms would be an interface error, since the scalar has no such term.

Treating last-record joint-head survival credit as final affinity benefit would be unsupported because decoded terminal learning labels are unavailable and no survival effect survives joint BH correction.
rationale: Decision: retain the incumbent (no operative edit). The Analyst's strongest signed endpoint contrasts are on pair-distance shell densities (pair_kernel_1.5-3.5, endpoint_effects:9-11, branch_adjusted:163/164/240/241) and on shape_yy (endpoint_effects:4, branch_adjusted:158/235), but the executing pointcloud scalar contains no pair-kernel, moment, joint-motif or geometry-block term (formula_registry diagnostic_limit; observable_definitions scope). No registered bounded declarative edit can express those contrasts: pointcloud_delta_A only changes the robust curvature of the Hungarian endpoint-distance reward, region_index/temporal_region_index only reweight landmark attention, teacher_neighbors only changes the detached nearest-k count, and temporal_teacher_blend only mixes the static and observed-teacher coordinate rewards. None of these is a pair-kernel or shape-tensor term, so an edit would not act on the observable the evidence favors. The temporal evidence does not support a time-conditioned alternative either: all 200 continuous rows have polynomial_accepted false, no extrapolation, relative node RMSE 0.28-1.00, multiple sign changes and strong sign conflicts, and the curve-fidelity audit retains only 24 curves with none of the audited landmark/pair curves passing (continuous:0-199, curve_support). A temporal derivative is not a coordinate gradient, so the observed-node linear contrasts cannot be converted into a spatial force. Joint-motion diagnostics (joint_diagnostics:1/2/11/14/15, branch_adjusted:74/76/151/153) are within-selector associations, not causal selection effects, and the teacher contrast is dominated by its internal fraction (0.787) rather than a rigid motion the pointcloud reward could target. Survival credit is weak and none survives joint BH correction (survival_effects:0/23/46/70/100/186/249/393), and decoded terminal learning labels are unavailable, so it cannot justify a direction. Turnover residuals are accounting diagnostics including score reclassification and extant-parent weighting (turnover:1/2/14/17/47/134/224/227/254/257/377/497/524/527/584/587), not causal selection effects. Parent-child increment contrasts disagree with endpoint contrasts in places (increment_effects:3/4/7/10/13/14/15/25/55), further weakening a directional edit. Temperatures are immutable and no temperature edit is proposed. Because the objective is affinity-primary and no permitted bounded declarative edit has a defensible expected advantage on the observable the evidence supports, retaining the incumbent is the correct choice; the evidence that would change this decision is a registered reward recipe that can express a pair-kernel or shape-tensor term, or a curve-fidelity-retained time-conditioned contrast.
